The few exceptions (like "aren", "haven") have very low activation values and appear to be noise.

[EXPLANATION]: Tokens that immediately precede a number, numeral, or alphanumeric identifier — typically labels introducing enumerated or numbered items such as steps, chapters, rules, sections, questions, equations, pages, versions, times, or serial numbers.
